pairs.why: A's rim has a soft rolled highlight and softer tick edges like the real clock; B's rim and ticks are flatter with a crisper thin contour and a hard ground shadow.
B's truss and housing are chunky, dark and soft-edged like the real ones; A's thin bright chrome truss has crisp high-contrast lines that the real card does not have.
Both show the same soft edges and the same dome frame lines, so edges give no reason to choose.
A's low-contrast dark-blue keys with soft edges match the real calculator's tonal edge density; B's white keys against blue make a high-contrast crisp grid the real card lacks.
Both use similar soft edges and similar hinge and panel seams, and neither differs clearly from the real card.
A has slightly fewer tiny edge details (rivets, button) and softer rails than B, which is closer to the real card's smooth chunky forms.
A's shield badge has a crisp gold border and B's has a rope ring, and both are busier than the real badge, while the brims and piping are similar.
Both have comparable soft leaf and trunk edges and a similar crisp frond serration, so edges give no preference.
